summary: SKK Holdings Ltd filed Amendment No. 1 to its prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5), reducing the aggregate offering price of Class A ordinary shares available under its existing sales agreement with A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners from $5,540,009 to $25,000. As of July 30, 2026, only $201,983.46 had been sold under the agreement. The reduction is administrative, and the sales agreement remains in effect until shares totaling $25,000 are sold or the agreement is terminated. This is a routine shelf takedown amendment, not a special situation.
